children: Motilal Oswal Asset Management Company has acquired shares worth Rs 30.48 crore in Spectrum Electrical Industries, while Fidelity has offloaded a 2.69 percent stake in Computer Age Management Services (CAMS) through open-market transactions on September 10.

Spectrum Electrical Industries shares hit a record high on Thursday, locking in the 5 percent upper circuit for the sixth consecutive session to end at a new high of Rs 2,878.6 on the National Stock Exchange.

According to bulk-deal data on the stock exchanges, Motilal Oswal Mutual Fund bought 1.15 lakh shares, representing a 0.73 percent stake in electrical components maker Spectrum Electrical Industries, from Ajay Bhikamchand Jain for Rs 30.48 crore.
The shares changed hands at Rs 2,651 apiece.
Fidelity sells 2.69% stake in CAMS; Goldman Sachs, Societe Generale buy 2.94% stake

Societe Generale ODI bought 37.11 lakh shares, representing a 1.49 percent stake in Computer Age Management Services, India's largest registrar and transfer agent for mutual funds, for Rs 253.05 crore. Goldman Sachs Investments Mauritius I picked up 35.96 lakh shares, or a 1.45 percent stake, for Rs 245.16 crore.
Together, they acquired a 2.94 percent stake at Rs 681.75 per share.

On the other side, Fidelity Rutland Square Trust II Strategic Advisers FIDEMG Markets Fund and FMRC Fidelity Emerging Markets Fund sold 66.97 lakh shares, or a 2.69 percent stake in CAMS, for Rs 456.64 crore. The shares were sold at Rs 681.8 per share.
CAMS recovered sharply from a low of Rs 681 after opening lower, and traded in a range for most of the session before closing at Rs 712, down 0.42 percent.
Bharat Battery Manufacturing Company buys 1.11% stake in Vedavaag Systems

The Bharat Battery Manufacturing Company Private Limited Provident Fund Institution, the employee provident fund trust of Bharat Battery Manufacturing Company, bought 2.61 lakh shares, or a 1.11 percent stake, in IT sales and services provider Vedavaag Systems for Rs 57.82 lakh.

The shares were purchased at Rs 22.1 apiece. The stock was locked in a 20 percent upper circuit to end at a new high of Rs 22.21 on the NSE, extending its strong run after a period of consolidation following its listing.

title: Motilal Oswal MF buys over Rs 30 crore shares in Spectrum Electrical; Fidelity sells 2.69% stake in CAMS
